basics.type: Non-profit Institution of Eminence Deemed to be University, established by the Government of Haryana
basics.ugc: Recognised by the UGC; Institution of Eminence (2020)
basics.campus: Fully residential campus in Sonipat, Haryana (Delhi NCR)
basics.other: 12 schools: law, business, international affairs, public policy, liberal arts, journalism, design and architecture, banking and finance, environment, psychology, languages and public health. No management, donation or NRI quota

admission: BBA (Hons.), B.Com and other UG programmes
Three rounds: Class 10 and 12 marks with a supplemental application, an entrance score (JSAT 50% or more, CUET or UGAT 60 percentile, SAT 1100 or ACT 27), then a faculty interview

scholarships.text: Merit-cum-means scholarships that waive tuition, based on family income, Class 12 marks, the entrance score and the interview. They are limited and given first-come, first-served.

hostel.text: JGU is a fully residential campus, so students live on campus.

fees.text: Tuition for the JGBS Immersive BBA (2026 intake) is ₹5,00,000 a year, with ₹1,25,000 paid to confirm the seat and a 10% yearly revision. Fees differ by programme; ask us for yours.
